summary.text: Julie Greene is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 50A, in office since January 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Chris Wedum. She is a former Edina School Board member and marketing professional.

paragraphs.text: Julie Greene earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Dayton, and Ballotpedia says her career includes work as a marketing professional.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former Edina School Board member and listed education as the first of her key campaign messages.
Greene defeated Owen Michaelson in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 50A and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
She serves on the Education Finance, Education Policy, and House Transportation Finance and Policy committees.
